info.name: Zenark backend-agent
info.description:
HTTP contract for the mental-health API and Exam Buddy (`python run.py`, port 8000).

Every request has saved examples for success, **400**, and **500**.

Error envelope (400 and 500, and also 401, 403, 404, 409, 429):
```
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {"code": "INVALID_REQUEST", "message": "...", "request_id": "..."},
  "detail": "..."
}
```
Codes: 400 INVALID_REQUEST, 401 UNAUTHORIZED, 403 FORBIDDEN, 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 CONFLICT, 429 RATE_LIMITED, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, 502 PROVIDER_ERROR, 503 NOT_READY.
Status 500 and above always use the message `An unexpected error occurred.`

Two mounts share one handler:
- `legacyMount` is empty by default, so auth, chat, journal, consultation, voice, and health are `/chat/send`. Set `legacyMount` to `/api/v1` for `/api/v1/chat/send`.
- `domainMount` is `/api` by default (`/api/mood`). Set it to `/api/v1` for `/api/v1/mood`.

Login and Signup store `accessToken` and `userId` on the collection. Other requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

Auth: none.
This request uses the default mount. The same handler is also at `/api/v1/health`.

**400** — This route has no body or query. A 400 is only the global validation envelope if the request is malformed.
**500** — any unhandled failure. The message is always `An unexpected error occurred.`; the exception text stays in the server log. Response header `X-Request-ID` is set.
